Order creation flow verified: mode=store+payment=cash => status=livree, payment_status=paye, stock decrements by qty then rolled back by test. 73/73 iter46+iter47+iter48 regression tests still pass (attendance, auth, catalog). Only pre-existing hydration warning (<span> inside <option>) in console — not iter49-related.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/orders.py POST /orders — stock decrement loop issues 3 sequential awaits per item (update_one base stock, optional update_one stock_by_size, then find_one). For a 10-item cart that is up to 30 round-trips. Consider bulk_write or at minimum merging the base + per-size $inc into a single update per item (pre-existing from server.py).

routers/orders.py POST /orders — no stock pre-check: if stock is 0 or negative, the decrement still runs and leaves stock negative (then flips status to liste_attente only when total_stk <= 0). An out-of-stock product can therefore be sold through POS. Pre-existing but worth flagging — add a guard that raises 400 'Rupture' when fresh.stock_by_size[size] < qty.

routers/orders.py POST /orders — mode='store' orders bypass delivery_fee validation but still accept delivery_fee>0, resulting in total that includes a phantom delivery fee for an in-store sale. Consider forcing delivery_fee=0 when mode=='store'.

routers/orders.py POST /pos/pin-authorize — PIN lookup uses body.pin.strip() but allows ANY admin/manager PIN to approve any requester's action (sales user approving their own cancellation would fail only because sales isn't in the role list). Good. However no rate-limiting: brute-forcing a 4-digit PIN against this endpoint is trivial (10 000 attempts). Add attempt throttling.
routers/orders.py POST /cash-sessions/open — accepts arbitrary opening_cash from client (even negative). Add validation opening_cash >= 0.

routers/orders.py POST /cash-sessions/{sid}/close — queries db.cash_movements with {'created_at': {'$gte': start}} but no upper bound. If a movement is created DURING the close call it is still included, which is fine; but if the session being closed is older and the same cashier opened a new one in between, the close will incorrectly include the newer session's movements. Scope by session_id (requires linking movements to session on creation).
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin 1234, manager 2222, sales 3333 all verified.
